newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Irkutskenergo 97 Q1 pre-tax down to 267 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Irkutskenergo 97 Q1 pre-tax down to 267 bln rbls.

text.p: NOTES -- Full company name is Irkutskoye AO Energetiki i Elektrifikatsii (Irkutskenergo) Figures prepared to Russian standards on an accruals basis.

Irkutskenergo said that at the end of 1996 it did not have debts payable to it after 12 months, while debts payable to it within 12 months rose to 3,681.2 billion roubles at the end of the first quarter of 1997 from 3,106.7 billion on January 1.
Credits owed rose by the end of the quarter to 3,211.4 billion roubles from 2,783.7 billion at the start of the year.
Irkutskenergo previously posted 1996 pre-tax profits on an accruals basis of 1.01 trillion roubles, after 808.35 billion roubles in 1995.
Irkutskenergo's main shareholders are the Russian government, which owns 40 percent, CS First Boston, which owns eight percent and Brunswick which owns eight percent.
Baikalsky Finansovy Dom and ChIF Energoinvest each own 3.5 percent of Irkutskenergo.
Irkutskenergo Level-1 American Depositary Receipts were issued in January this year and trade on the Berlin and Frankfurt stock exchanges, among others.
